To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

tank mixes of the glyphosate-based formulation Roundup klasic Pro® with surfactant Wetic® or Agrovital® significantly decrease the predatory activities of wolf spiders in Pardosa genus in the short term.

the tank mix of the herbicide formulation Round-up klasik Pro® with the surfactants Wetcit® and Agrovital® significantly decreased the predatory activity of wolf spiders in laboratory conditions, whereas Roundup klasik® Pro® itself did not.

the tank mixes of the herbicide Roundup klasik® Pro and two different tank-mixing surfactants significantly decreased the predatory activity of the spiders in the short-term, while the herbicide itself did not have any significant effect.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the possible negative effects of tank-mixed herbicide formulations on beneficial arthropod predators.
the effects of herbicide formulations, adjuvants, and herbicide-and-adjuvants tank mixes on the predatory activity of wolf spiders.
the effects of plant protection products on the environment and beneficial arthropods.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the use of tank mixes of glyphosate-based herbicides and surfactants is not advisable, especially in agroecosystem where the beneficial arthropods, such as wolf spiders in the family Lycosidae, are important.
tank mixes of herbicides and surfactants are not as safe for beneficial arthropods (and other nontarget organisms) as are herbicides alone.
the use of plant protection tank mixes in the field may be harmful for the environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of herbicide and surfactant tank mixtures may have a significant negative impact on the environment, and that such effects should be tested in detail.
tank mixes of herbicides with surfactants may have a negative impact on beneficial arthropod populations.
tank mixtures of Roundup klasik with Wetcit or Agrovital have synergistic effects that are negative for wolf spiders, but not for the herbicide alone.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effects of tank mixes on beneficial arthropod species are not necessarily predictable from the effects of individual components.
the effects of herbicide-and-surface mixtures on non-target organisms should be studied in more detail.
the use of tank-mixing surfactants in agrochemicals is not harmless and should be further studied.
